title: Spherical codes: N points on the sphere in R^d with the smallest largest cosine
keeper: H. Cohn, table of spherical codes (spherical-codes.org)
revision: the table's front page, read 9 Nov 2026 04:23 UTC (14,825 entries; SHA-256 0f9353613fea9193...)

template.title: Spherical code: {n} points on the sphere in R^{d}
template.statement: Place {n} points on the unit sphere in R^{d} so that the largest cosine between two distinct points is as small as possible.
template.submission: Text file: {n} lines, each one point given by its {d} coordinates separated by commas (any length: the checker normalises every point in 50-digit decimal arithmetic); other lines are ignored, as on spherical-codes.org.

score: the largest cosine between two of the points (smaller is better)
best_text: The best known value in Henry Cohn's table is {best} ({holder}), rounded up to 12 decimals; a code improves it when its largest cosine is smaller by at least one unit in the 12th decimal.
holder_sources: the first reference or credit in the entry's notes on the table's front page
open_rule: every entry not marked optimal (*) in the table
